summary: Poke from range and reposition instead of trading: protect the archers, keep Taculla back until the endgame, punish anyone who closes in.
notes: Damage is low, survivability is high: win by never letting the opponent connect.
Wind Archer and Wind Mage do the work; Deceivers next to them punish anyone who steps in.
Perplexing Tempest slows the enemy approach; Blast and Hypnotic Call punish a committed attack.
Mind Capture is positional, not economic: take a unit to open a lane or blunt a rush, not for value.
